我的生活与健康生活(My Life and a healthy life): 一篇关于健康生活的A2短文:利奥与妮娜的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the gym by bike. Leo and Nina had great fun there. The weather was snowy that day. What's more, the brave girl saved her brother from the water.
Leo hopes to visit Paris one day. Life is full of small surprises. The gym is one of the best places in the city. In fact, don't be jealous of your sister's new bike.
Leo thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Nina is interested in cooking. Leo borrowed a book about English from the museum. In fact, he was embarrassed by the praise.
Leo plays baseball with Nina every Monday. Leo is going to travel to Paris in June. Leo learned a lot about English.
